sentences.en: You cannot be too polite when you meet the president.
sentences.zh: 在见到总统时，你再怎么有礼貌都不为过。

sentences.en: He is bright, and what is more, he is polite.
sentences.zh: 他很聪明，而且很有礼貌。

sentences.en: He took off his hat and made a polite bow.
sentences.zh: 他脱下帽子，鞠了一躬，非常客气。

senses.zh: 有礼貌的,有教养的，文雅的,上流社会的,应酬的，客套的
